name: Grixto
slug: Grixto is a mobile antagonist proxy seeking Al Kurin and hiding his phylactery among mundane possessions.
description: Grixto is a proxy associated with the campaign's main antagonist. He may use caves near the dragon training grounds as a hideout and can apparently move between arches, making his location uncertain. He is associated with Galixtar and has been seen near the Dragon Rider training grounds in The Reach.

log.summary: Grixto was suspected of collecting Al Kurin from trainees, including juvenile dragons, and may have been hiding near the Dragon Rider training grounds. A vision showed him there in The Reach alongside Galixtar, but he may be able to move between arches. The party believes his phylactery is a mundane object kept on his person; his repeated possession of small chess-like or war-game pieces may be a clue. Sylan theorizes that Grixto learned to use the keystones through information in the archives at the ruined site. Walker and Plymouth are investigating the training grounds for clues to Grixto and Galixtar's whereabouts.
